einzeiler: Bill Hader talks SNL memories, directing Barry, and his early days in comedy.
kurzfassung: Bill Hader joins the hosts to discuss his unexpected journey to Saturday Night Live, triggered by a recommendation from Megan Mullally. He reflects on the intense creative environment at SNL, working on the Digital Shorts, and his transition into directing with his hit series Barry. The conversation also covers humorous anecdotes about industry parties, dental emergencies, and sharing sets with legendary actors like Henry Winkler.
stichpunkte: Megan Mullally discovered Bill Hader at a Second City show and directly recommended him to Lorne Michaels.
Hader spent four nervous hours waiting outside Lorne Michaels' office before his first meeting.
During his early seasons on SNL, Hader struggled with crippling insecurity and anxiety.
He collaborated closely with The Lonely Island crew on iconic digital shorts like Dear Sister.
Alec Berg and Hader created the HBO series Barry after a conversation about wanting to direct.
Henry Winkler's endearing and unpredictable behavior on the set of Barry is a constant source of amusement.
Hader shares stories about his severe nut allergy and a recent accidental exposure while eating vegan lasagna.

clips.hook: Dying in total silence during dress rehearsal.
clips.text: A specific sketch bombed so completely during the run-through that the performer could hear every ambient sound in the massive studio.
